title: Novelties and opponent preparation

D0.outcome: Explains a novelty as a move that leaves known theory at a point where the position favours the prepared player, and what opponent preparation means.

D1.outcome: Finds an improvement in a known line and writes a verified justification.

D2.outcome: Prepares against a specific opponent: predicts the line he will play and prepares a reply or novelty.

D3.outcome: Reports a verified novelty with the engine depth and settings and says what remains unproven.

misconceptions: The engine's first move is a novelty.
conditions: Engine results are evidence under recorded limits, not proofs.
condition_sources: SCH, Settings recorded for every check
contrasts: A novelty found by the engine but not understood.
